reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that bundles 21 agent-invoked content creation, document processing, media handling, web retrieval, and social publishing skills, with some capabilities requiring browsers, credentials, or external services.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 21 个智能体技能的插件，用于内容生成与处理、媒体工具、网页信息提取及微信公众号、微博和 X 发布。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundling 21 agent skills for content generation and processing, media utilities, web retrieval, and publishing to WeChat, Weibo, and X.

capabilities: Registers 21 agent-invoked skills in DeepSeek Harness
Generates illustrations, cover images, comics, infographics, image cards, and slide images
Formats and converts Markdown, translates text, converts URLs or posts to Markdown, and retrieves YouTube transcripts
Publishes content to WeChat Official Accounts, Weibo, and X/Twitter
Compresses images, draws diagrams, extracts Electron application resources, generates images through multiple backends, and provides a Gemini Web reverse proxy
May use browser automation, external APIs, login credentials, and network services
